fields.statement: Verified commit 78c179d91. The acceptance grep (IndexPath = "" outside tests in internal/api) prints nothing. go test -trimpath -count=1 -p 2 ./internal/api -run '^(TestDaemonHomePrefersWorkingProject|TestPollGitBounded|TestGateAnswer|TestInboxGate|TestWebAnswerAction|TestWebApproveAction|TestSessionBrief|TestDriverPollIsCheap|TestEvidenceReadsPastSessionWrites|TestOtherRoot)' passes, TestOtherRoot{DaemonProject,InboxGateRead,GateAnswer,Unreadable} included. Each runs with an own-index case and a throwaway case. In the own-index case the worktree's index file exists under the test HOME's .cache, and the answers are as expected: ls lists other-plan-intent; inbox statements; question.answer --run writes to the worktree, not the caller; gateAnswered goes false then true. When the root is unreadable the result is unchanged: empty statements, or the no Rhiza repository error. TestPropertyProjectionParity passes. The scripts daemon-projects, inbox-gate-questions and inbox-projects pass, with RHIZA_/SHIP_/REX_ unset. go vet ./internal/api is clean. rhiza ship generate and rhiza render, run with this commit's build in a detached worktree, changed nothing. In the diff, the one rootIndexPath helper (workspace.go) feeds projectCtx, gateAnswerCtx, inboxGateRead, run_brief, run_model_cache and openRootWorkspace. gateAnswered no longer clears IndexPath. There is no log-fold fallback and no TODOs, and the root each op reads is unchanged.
